Comfortable spanning deep technical design, incident command, and executive communication; known for turning ambiguous reliability goals into measurable SLOs that engineering and product teams actually adopt. custom-text.text: I believe reliability is a product feature, not a tax. The best platforms make the safe path the easy path: sensible defaults, clear guardrails, fast feedback, and incident reviews that focus on systems rather than individuals. I optimise for teams that can operate what they build and for architectures that fail in predictable, recoverable ways.
